graham.brief:
Minnesota has its quarterback question answered again, and the rest of this read follows from it. Kyler Murray sat out week 2 and is back for week 3. The books hung Murray at 30.5 pass attempts, and he's averaged 5 all season. The sheet changed; the season average hasn't.

Tampa Bay's pass defense gives up more through the air than almost anyone, 10th-worst in the league. Minnesota plays slow, 2nd-fewest plays a game. That leaves the players, which is where I'd rather be anyway.

Minnesota gets clean runs before contact, and Tampa Bay loads the box to stop exactly that. Baker Mayfield is the starter who's played 100% of the snaps.

The spread has moved a point toward Minnesota. Now set the market next to it; the two mostly rhyme. Minnesota is favored by 1 with a 43 total. Nothing separates on my side either. Jones' carry line has slipped, which usually means the books see Minnesota throwing to catch up. Nothing here is settled. The opening script for Minnesota is the first honest evidence.
